alex: Quick questionUsing the JS SDK in an Expo dev client (Hermes). Metro resolves the ESM import and runtime crashes because global.crypto is undefined and ReadableStream is missing. Anyone have a minimal set of fixes? :confused:

sam: Metro + exports field can force the import entry. Do you have a cjs build? If so, prefer that for RN.

alex: SDK has both, but package.json exports point import -> dist/index.mjs so Metro picks it. Also types import node:stream and tsc drags in Node lib defs.

marta: Workarounds we use: 1) metro resolver override to map to the CJS file, 2) polyfills for getRandomValues and ReadableStream.

ben: Metro patch example: ```js
// metro.config.js
const path = require('path')
module.exports = { resolver: { extraNodeModules: { crypto: path.resolve(__dirname, 'shims/crypto.js') } } }
```

alex: For polyfills we added `react-native-get-random-values`, `web-streams-polyfill`, and an AbortController polyfill. Still needed to set skipLibCheck in tsconfig because of node types.

sam: Long-term asks to open against the SDK: (1) add a `react-native` field or make `main` point to CJS, (2) provide RN-friendly types (or conditional types), (3) document RN/Expo guide with metro hacks and polyfills, (4) publish a lightweight browser/UMD build that avoids Node-only deps.

marta: Also suggest a tiny shim package for ReadableStream that works with Hermeswe found `web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill` reliable. Example shim: ```js
if (!global.ReadableStream) global.ReadableStream = require('web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill').ReadableStream
```

alex: I'll file an issue with repro (expo prebuild + Hermes) and include these bullets + metro snippet. If anyone has a small repro already, please add it.

expo-bot: FYI Expo SDK 48+ surfaces crypto.getRandomValues in managed runtime; dev clients may still need manual polyfills for older versions. See blog.expo.dev for details.

ben: TL;DR checklist to unblock: install react-native-get-random-values, web-streams-polyfill, abortcontroller-polyfill; add shims import at app entry; metro mapping for crypto; set skipLibCheck until upstream types are fixed.
